patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than LeadIQ's shape. Choose LeadIQ only if your buying job matches “Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pr” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; LeadIQ leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and LeadIQ share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; LeadIQ is Chrome/LinkedIn-adjacent capture and CRM sync with Universal Credits — Free 50 credits; Pro from $200/mo..
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs LeadIQ-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; LeadIQ — Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

Limitations — BookYourData: —; LeadIQ: Pro starts at $200/mo — higher entry than many SMB contact tools; Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms.
